'''Joan Carles Toscano Beltrán''' (born 14 August 1984) is an Andorran international [[Association football|footballer]] who plays for [[UE Sant Julià]], as a [[Forward (association football)#Centre-forward|striker]].

==Career==
He has played for [[CE Principat]], [[FC Santa Coloma]], [[CF Gimnástico Alcázar]], [[CD Binéfar]], [[FC Andorra]], [[FC Ordino]] and [[Inter Club d'Escaldes]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=20832|accessdate=16 November 2018}}</ref>

In January 2019, Toscano joined [[UE Sant Julià]].<ref>[https://www.elperiodic.ad/noticia/69018/toski-i-juanma-hernandez-al-sant-julia 'Toski' i Juanma Hernández, al Sant Julià], elperiodic.ad, 5 January 2019</ref>

He made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2006.<ref name = "NFT"/>
